ServiceRequest.title: Service Request
ServiceRequest.description: A request for a service from a customer.

details.description: A JSON string containing the full briefing data.

status.description: The current status of the request.

requestDate.description: The date the request was made.

publicId.description: A unique public ID for sharing the quote.

quoteDetails.description: A JSON string containing the generated quote data (price, timeline, etc.).

customerFeedback.description: Feedback or comments from the customer on the quote.

/service_requests/{serviceRequestId}.description: Stores all incoming service requests from the briefing form.
